M03 Binding Open / Get

PROPOSED_PENDING_REACCEPTANCE_AND_OWNER · planning only · 黃卡維持 · author checks are not independent acceptance

Attach and observe an existing M04 owner without creating another document authority. This packet covers open and get completely as a document model. Close and transfer remain deferred; full lifecycle is not complete.

Architecture

Native UI → Caller Adapter → M03 Derived Facade → M04 Attach/Get Port → M04 sole S1 owner
Trusted native identity → M04 identity-bound observation → immutable view projection
M03 never initializes S1, writes content, performs save IO, ACK or material pin.

Review / evidence

Review policy before/after, complete roots, BDD, model fixtures and source comparison below. Runtime, native UI, valid RED, product build and full Draft validation: NOT RUN. Independent acceptance and Owner adoption: PENDING.

Purpose and boundaries

Attach an authorized native view to an identity-bound M04 owner and read current immutable projection without creating another owner or mutating document state

Primary moduleM03 derived binding facade
Authoritative ownerM04 only; exactly one existing S1
OpenAuthorized main/editor attaches already identity-bound owner
GetCurrent instance reads immutable projection; explicit viewer attachment allowed
TransactionVerify native sender and M04 observation before deriving attachment
Content / history / baselinesPreserved in every document-model case
Formal IO / ACK / material pinNOT CALLED
Close / transferDeferred; external revocation observations only

Behavior coverage

B1 Primary successApplicableBG-01/open and BG-02/get
B2 Input boundariesApplicableempty reference, UUID controls, u64 maximum and overflow
B3 Invalid inputApplicableclosed roots, missing/unknown fields
B4 Dependency failureApplicableBG-05 missing integration; proof mismatch
B5 Partial failureApplicableInvalid observation leaves no partial facade attachment
B6 State consistencyApplicableAll document model cases preserve content/history/baselines/revision
B7 TransactionApplicableAttach only after full trusted context verification
B8 LifecycleApplicableOld generation/session/native instance rejected; delivery fenced
B9 Recovery/rollbackNot ApplicableNo content mutation or rollback. Restart binding invalidation covered without reconciliation implementation
B10 Cross-moduleApplicableM04/M01 fixture-shaped observations only; real integration pending
B11 CompatibilityDeferredReal native OS/platform and existing UI integration require separately approved Skeleton/RED
B12 Regression criticalDeferredOld accepted document suites not rerun; product regression NOT RUN

Open decisions / risk

All new policy choices remain PROPOSED_PENDING_REACCEPTANCE_AND_OWNER. The M04 integration provider is a required external seam; it is not established by this fixture packet. Native window nonces and trusted context are adapter evidence, never UI-supplied authority. No product implementation, native verification or complete lifecycle claim.

"""Generate proposed open/get document packet only; never imports product code."""
import copy, hashlib, html, json, pathlib, re, shutil, subprocess, sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
P=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=next(x for x in P.parents if (x/'.git').exists())
CENTRAL=P.parents[2]/'integration-contract-revision-v3'
BASE=P.parent/'candidate-prepare-correction'
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf8'))
def write(n,x):(P/n).write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def walk(x,p=''):
 if isinstance(x,dict):
  yield p,x
  for k,v in x.items():yield from walk(v,p+'/'+k)
 elif isinstance(x,list):
  for i,v in enumerate(x):yield from walk(v,p+'/'+str(i))
def main():
 strict=read(BASE/'request.schema.json')['$defs']; corrections=read(BASE/'response.schema.json')['$defs']
 sources=[P.parent/'current-state.json',P.parent/'envelope.json',P.parent/'cx-h2-revision-v3/module-spec.json',P.parent/'cx-h2-revision-v3/shared-contract.json',BASE/'schema_subset.py',BASE/'request.schema.json',BASE/'response.schema.json',ROOT/'AGENTS.md',ROOT/'apps/sgenaxis-desktop/crates/sgenaxis-work/src/document_edit.rs']
 roots={};diff=[]
 for command in ['open','get']:
  for direction in ['request','response']:
   n='h2-design_binding_'+command+'-'+direction+'.schema.json';source=CENTRAL/n;sources.append(source)
   old=read(source);new=copy.deepcopy(old)
   for key in ['U64Decimal','Digest']:new['$defs'][key]=copy.deepcopy(strict[key])
   new['$defs']['Error']=copy.deepcopy(corrections['Error'])
   uuid=next(v for _,v in walk(read(BASE/'request.schema.json')) if 'pattern'in v and '[0-9a-f]{8}' in v['pattern'])
   for field in ['binding_ref','document_uuid','session_uuid']:
    new['$defs']['BindingProjection']['properties'][field]=copy.deepcopy(uuid)
   if command=='get' and direction=='request':new['properties']['binding_ref']=copy.deepcopy(uuid)
   roots[n]=new;write(n,new)
   diff.append({'root':n,'source_sha256':sha(source),'before':old,'after':new,'status':'PROPOSED_PENDING_REACCEPTANCE_AND_OWNER'})
 shutil.copyfile(BASE/'schema_subset.py',P/'schema_subset.py')
 write('before-after.json',diff)
 write('source-hashes.json',{str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'):sha(p) for p in sources})
 authority=read(P.parents[2]/'M01/planning/s2-green/source-current.json');current={n:sha(ROOT/n) if (ROOT/n).is_file() else None for n in authority['source_hashes']}
 write('source-current.json',{'branch':subprocess.check_output(['git','branch','--show-current'],text=True,cwd=ROOT).strip(),'HEAD':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True,cwd=ROOT).strip(),'historical_packet_HEAD':'5b709343a890503ebbe24a802e43cda5647df124','historical_M01_authority_HEAD':authority['head'],'authority':'M01/planning/s2-green/source-current.json','authority_count':len(current),'current_hashes':current,'drift':[n for n,v in current.items() if v!=authority['source_hashes'][n]],'meaning':'M01 S2 historical Green authority compared; not M03 integration evidence'})

 write('lessons.json',{'cause':'Shared schemas contain weak projections and regex end anchors that accept controls; source-shaped fixtures can otherwise be mistaken for issuer proof','correction':'Use strict corrected definitions, generic schema validators, enumerate every physical pattern and root reachability; fixture trust authority separate from wire values','scope':'New open/get packet only; no old suite rerun'})
 from check_documents import run
 run()
 files=sorted(p for p in P.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name not in ['index.html','artifact-hashes.json'])
 def table(rows):return '<table>'+''.join('<tr>'+''.join('<td>'+html.escape(str(x))+'</td>' for x in row)+'</tr>' for row in rows)+'</table>'
 body='<h2>Purpose and boundaries</h2><p>'+html.escape(spec['intent'])+'</p>'+table([['Primary module','M03 derived binding facade'],['Authoritative owner','M04 only; exactly one existing S1'],['Open','Authorized main/editor attaches already identity-bound owner'],['Get','Current instance reads immutable projection; explicit viewer attachment allowed'],['Transaction','Verify native sender and M04 observation before deriving attachment'],['Content / history / baselines','Preserved in every document-model case'],['Formal IO / ACK / material pin','NOT CALLED'],['Close / transfer','Deferred; external revocation observations only']])
 body+='<h2>Behavior coverage</h2>'+table([[x['category'],x['status'],x['evidence_or_reason']] for x in spec['BDD_coverage']])
 v=read(P/'verification.json');body+='<h2>Verification boundaries</h2>'+table([[k,v[k]] for k in ['python_root_cases','python_definition_cases','model_cases','delivery_cases','independent_acceptance','fullDraft','product','native','RED','build','Owner']])
 body+='<h2>Open decisions / risk</h2><p>All new policy choices remain PROPOSED_PENDING_REACCEPTANCE_AND_OWNER. The M04 integration provider is a required external seam; it is not established by this fixture packet. Native window nonces and trusted context are adapter evidence, never UI-supplied authority. No product implementation, native verification or complete lifecycle claim.</p><h2>Detailed machine artifacts and complete embedded documents</h2>'
 body+=''.join('<details><summary>'+html.escape(p.name)+'</summary><pre>'+html.escape(p.read_text(encoding='utf8'))+'</pre></details>' for p in files)
 (P/'index.html').write_text('<!doctype html><html lang="zh-Hant"><meta charset="utf-8"><title>M03 binding open/get proposal</title><style>body{font:16px system-ui;max-width:1100px;margin:40px auto;background:#101820;color:#e3edf5}h1,h2{color:#83d8d0}pre{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}details{border:1px solid #426070;padding:12px;margin:12px 0}.badge{color:#ffcb72}a{color:#8adcf0}</style><h1>M03 Binding Open / Get</h1><p class="badge">PROPOSED_PENDING_REACCEPTANCE_AND_OWNER · planning only · 黃卡維持 · author checks are not independent acceptance</p><p>Attach and observe an existing M04 owner without creating another document authority. This packet covers open and get completely as a document model. Close and transfer remain deferred; full lifecycle is not complete.</p><h2>Architecture</h2><pre>Native UI → Caller Adapter → M03 Derived Facade → M04 Attach/Get Port → M04 sole S1 owner\nTrusted native identity → M04 identity-bound observation → immutable view projection\nM03 never initializes S1, writes content, performs save IO, ACK or material pin.</pre><h2>Review / evidence</h2><p>Review policy before/after, complete roots, BDD, model fixtures and source comparison below. Runtime, native UI, valid RED, product build and full Draft validation: NOT RUN. Independent acceptance and Owner adoption: PENDING.</p>'+body+'<script type="application/json" id="module-spec">'+json.dumps(spec,ensure_ascii=False).replace('</','<\/')+'</script></html>',encoding='utf8')
 write('artifact-hashes.json',{p.name:sha(p) for p in P.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name!='artifact-hashes.json'})
if __name__=='__main__':main()

check_documents.py
"""Generic schema and pure document oracle checks. Not production or native proof."""
import copy, json, pathlib, re, subprocess, sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
P=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(n):return json.loads((P/n).read_text(encoding='utf8'))
def write(n,x):(P/n).write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
def walk(x,p=''):
 if isinstance(x,dict):
  yield p,x
  for k,v in x.items():yield from walk(v,p+'/'+k)
 elif isinstance(x,list):
  for i,v in enumerate(x):yield from walk(v,p+'/'+str(i))
def resolve(root,ref):
 x=root
 for k in ref[2:].split('/'):x=x[k]
 return x
def sample(s):
 if 'const'in s:return copy.deepcopy(s['const'])
 if 'enum'in s:return s['enum'][0]
 if 'pattern'in s:
  if '[0-9a-f]{8}'in s['pattern']:return 'abcdef01-abcd-4abc-8abc-abcdef012345'
  if '{64}'in s['pattern']:return 'abcdef01'*8
  return '7'
 t=s.get('type');t=t[0] if isinstance(t,list) else t
 return {'string':'x','boolean':False,'array':[],'null':None}.get(t)
def witness(root,s,branches):
 if '$ref'in s:return witness(root,resolve(root,s['$ref']),branches)
 if 'oneOf'in s:return witness(root,s['oneOf'][branches.pop(0) if branches else 0],branches)
 if s.get('type')=='object':return {k:witness(root,v,branches) for k,v in s.get('properties',{}).items() if k in s.get('required',[])}
 return sample(s)
def routes(root,s,sp='',ip=(),branches=(),refs=()):
 if '$ref'in s:
  assert s['$ref']not in refs
  yield from routes(root,resolve(root,s['$ref']),s['$ref'][1:],ip,branches,refs+(s['$ref'],));return
 if 'pattern'in s:yield {'schema_pointer':sp+'/pattern','instance_path':list(ip),'branches':list(branches),'ref_chain':list(refs)}
 for i,z in enumerate(s.get('oneOf',[])):yield from routes(root,z,sp+'/oneOf/'+str(i),ip,branches+(i,),refs)
 for k,z in s.get('properties',{}).items():yield from routes(root,z,sp+'/properties/'+k,ip+(k,),branches,refs)
 if 'items'in s:yield from routes(root,s['items'],sp+'/items',ip+('*',),branches,refs)
def values(s):
 v=sample(s);kind='uuid' if '[0-9a-f]{8}'in s['pattern'] else 'digest' if '{64}'in s['pattern'] else 'u64'
 a=[('canonical',v,True),('empty','',False),('number',7,False),('prefix','x'+v,False),('suffix',v+'x',False)]
 a.extend((repr(t),v+t,False) for t in ['\n','\r','\r\n','\0','\t','\x85','\u2028','\u2029'])
 if kind=='u64':a.extend((v,v,ok) for v,ok in [('0',True),('9007199254740993',True),('18446744073709551615',True),('18446744073709551616',False),('01',False),('-1',False),('1e0',False),('1.0',False)])
 else:a.extend([('uppercase',v.upper(),False),('short',v[:-1],False),('long',v+'0',False)])
 return a
def run():
 from schema_subset import Draft202012Validator
 from document_model import fixtures, reduce, deliver, delivery_fixtures
 roots={n:read(n) for n in read('module-spec.json')['roots']};audit=[];trace=[];cases=[];physical=[]
 for n,root in roots.items():
  Draft202012Validator.check_schema(root)
  rr=list(routes(root,root))
  for p,s in walk(root):
   if '$ref'in s:assert s['$ref'].startswith('#/');resolve(root,s['$ref'])
   if 'pattern'not in s:continue
   matching=[r for r in rr if r['schema_pointer']==p+'/pattern']
   audit.append({'schema':n,'pointer':p+'/pattern','pattern':s['pattern'],'reachability':'ROOT_REACHABLE' if matching else 'UNREACHABLE_SHARED_DEF','routes':len(matching),'policy':'strict lexical end from prepare correction; no field-name hook'})
   for label,v,expected in values(s):
    if not isinstance(v,str):continue
    physical.append({'schema':n,'pointer':p+'/pattern','pattern':s['pattern'],'value':v,'expected':expected,'id':n+p+label})
  for r in rr:
   assert '*'not in r['instance_path'];trace.append(dict(r,schema=n))
   s=resolve(root,'#'+r['schema_pointer'][:-8]);base=witness(root,root,r['branches'].copy())
   for label,value,expected in values(s):
    x=copy.deepcopy(base);t=x
    for k in r['instance_path'][:-1]:t=t[k]
    t[r['instance_path'][-1]]=value
    cases.append({'id':n+str(len(cases))+label,'schema':n,'instance':x,'expected_accept':expected})
  # Closed complete root counterexamples are independent of lexical fields.
  base=witness(root,root,[])
  cases.append({'id':n+':base','schema':n,'instance':base,'expected_accept':True})
  extra=copy.deepcopy(base);extra['unapproved']=True
  cases.append({'id':n+':unknown','schema':n,'instance':extra,'expected_accept':False})
  for k in base:
   missing=copy.deepcopy(base);del missing[k]
   cases.append({'id':n+':missing:'+k,'schema':n,'instance':missing,'expected_accept':False})
 # Seven exact domain variant objects remain schema-checked even when not emitted by open/get.
 for n,root in roots.items():
  if '-response.'not in n:continue
  domains=[s for s in root['$defs']['Error']['oneOf'] if s['properties']['code'].get('enum')==['DomainRejected'] or s['properties']['code'].get('const')=='DomainRejected'];assert len(domains)==7
  for domain in domains:
   branch=domain['properties']['details']
   d=witness(root,branch,[]);x={'ok':False,'error':{'code':'DomainRejected','details':d},'replayed':False}
   cases.append({'id':n+':domain:'+d['code'],'schema':n,'instance':x,'expected_accept':True})
   y=copy.deepcopy(x);y['error']['details']['fields']='Debug string forbidden'
   cases.append({'id':n+':domain-string:'+d['code'],'schema':n,'instance':y,'expected_accept':False})
 results=[]
 for c in cases:
  try:Draft202012Validator(roots[c['schema']]).validate(c['instance']);actual=True
  except AssertionError:actual=False
  assert actual==c['expected_accept'],c['id'];results.append({'id':c['id'],'actual':actual,'expected':c['expected_accept']})
 for c in physical:assert (re.search(c['pattern'],c['value'])is not None)==c['expected'],c['id']
 models=fixtures();mr=[]
 for c in models:
  before=copy.deepcopy(c['state']);after,response,calls=reduce(c['state'],c['command'],c['request'],c['caller'],c['evidence'])
  assert response==c['expected_response'],c['id']
  assert calls==c['expected_calls'],c['id']
  assert after==c['expected_after'],c['id']
  for k in ['content','history','baselines','revision']:assert after[k]==before[k],c['id']+k
  Draft202012Validator(roots['h2-design_binding_'+c['command']+'-response.schema.json']).validate(response)
  mr.append({'id':c['id'],'response':response,'calls':calls,'state_unchanged':after==before,'content_history_baselines_revision_unchanged':True})
 deliveries=delivery_fixtures();dr=[]
 for c in deliveries:
  display,status=deliver(c['display'],c['pending'],c['response'],c['current'])
  assert display==c['expected_display'] and status==c['expected_status'],c['id']
  dr.append({'id':c['id'],'status':status,'formal_ACK':'NOT CALLED','content_mutation':'NOT CALLED'})
 write('delivery-fixtures.json',deliveries);write('delivery-results.json',dr)
 feature='Feature: Exact proposed open and get observable cases\n  Background:\n    Given document attachment policies await independent review and Owner adoption\n  Rule: Only the current authorized view receives an unchanged document projection\n'
 for c in models:
  outcome='the current immutable projection is returned' if c['expected_response']['ok'] else c['expected_response']['error']['code']+' is reported'
  feature+='    Scenario: '+c['id']+'\n      Given the document attachment condition named '+c['id'].replace('BG-','').replace('-',' ')+'\n      When the view requests '+('an attachment' if c['command']=='open' else 'its current projection')+'\n      Then '+outcome+'\n      And document content, history and baselines remain unchanged\n'
 for c in deliveries:
  feature+='    Scenario: '+c['id']+'\n      Given a projection response is pending for the original view\n      And the current view condition is '+c['id'].replace('BG-delivery-','').replace('-',' ')+'\n      When the response arrives\n      Then the delivery decision is '+c['expected_status']+'\n      And no document acknowledgement is applied\n'
 (P/'case-scenarios.feature').write_text(feature,encoding='utf8')
 write('traceability.json',[{'Requirement':'BG-authorized-attach-and-observe','BDD':c['id'],'Contract':'C1-C9','TDD':'document_model fixture '+c['id'],'level':'DOCUMENT_MODEL_ONLY','result':'AUTHOR_CHECKED','product_TDD':'NOT RUN','task':'BG-PREP-OPEN-GET'} for c in models+deliveries])
 write('lexical-audit.json',audit);write('root-occurrence-trace.json',trace);write('lexical-fixtures.json',cases);write('pattern-fixtures.json',physical);write('fixtures.json',models);write('model-results.json',mr)
 write('all-string-constraints.json',[{'root':n,'pointer':p,'constraints':s} for n,r in roots.items() for p,s in walk(r) if s.get('type')=='string' or isinstance(s.get('type'),list)and 'string'in s['type']])
 node=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['node',str(P/'probe.cjs')],text=True));assert not node['mismatches']
 write('verification.json',{'status':'AUTHOR_DOCUMENT_CHECKED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW','author':'/root/m03_binding_lifecycle_packet','independent_acceptance':'PENDING','python_root_cases':len(results),'python_definition_cases':len(physical),'model_cases':len(mr),'delivery_cases':len(dr),'node':node,'old_suites':'NOT RERUN','fullDraft':'NOT RUN','product':'NOT RUN','native':'NOT RUN','RED':'NOT RUN','build':'NOT RUN','Owner':'NOT ADOPTED','module_complete':False})
 print(json.dumps({'document_roots':len(roots),'root_cases':len(results),'definition_cases':len(physical),'model_cases':len(mr),'delivery_cases':len(dr),'node':node}))
if __name__=='__main__':run()

"""Pure proposed document oracle, not an implementation Skeleton or runtime owner."""
import copy, json, pathlib
P=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
UID='abcdef01-abcd-4abc-8abc-abcdef012345'
DOC='abcdef02-abcd-4abc-8abc-abcdef012345'
SESSION='abcdef03-abcd-4abc-8abc-abcdef012345'
PROJECT='abcdef04-abcd-4abc-8abc-abcdef012345'
def error(code,details=None):return {'ok':False,'error':{'code':code,'details':details or {}},'replayed':False}
def success(value):return {'ok':True,'value':copy.deepcopy(value),'replayed':False}
def deliver(display,pending,response,current):
 """Pure UI projection ordering oracle; never applies any owner mutation/ACK."""
 before=copy.deepcopy(display)
 if not response['ok']:return before,'DiagnosticOnly'
 value=response['value']
 if not current['live'] or pending['instance']!=current['instance']:return before,'DiscardRetiredInstance'
 for field in ['binding_ref','document_uuid','session_uuid','owner_generation']:
  if pending[field]!=current[field] or value[field]!=current[field]:return before,'DiscardStaleAuthority'
 if int(value['revision'])<int(display['revision']):return before,'DiscardOlderProjection'
 return copy.deepcopy(value),'InstalledProjectionOnly'
def delivery_fixtures():
 projection={'binding_ref':UID,'document_uuid':DOC,'session_uuid':SESSION,'owner_generation':'7','revision':'9','design_json':'{"nodes":[]}','dirty':True,'can_edit':False,'unsupported':[],'selection':None,'persistence_ready':False}
 current={k:projection[k] for k in ['binding_ref','document_uuid','session_uuid','owner_generation']};current.update(instance='native-main-1',live=True)
 pending=copy.deepcopy(current);cases=[]
 def add(id,change=None,revision=None,expected='InstalledProjectionOnly'):
  c=copy.deepcopy(current);c.update(change or {});v=copy.deepcopy(projection)
  if revision:v['revision']=revision
  after=v if expected=='InstalledProjectionOnly' else projection
  cases.append({'id':id,'display':copy.deepcopy(projection),'pending':copy.deepcopy(pending),'response':success(v),'current':c,'expected_display':copy.deepcopy(after),'expected_status':expected,'formal_ACK':'NOT CALLED','material_pin':'NOT CALLED','save_proof':'NOT APPLICABLE'})
 add('BG-delivery-current')
 add('BG-delivery-newer',revision='9007199254740993')
 add('BG-delivery-older',revision='8',expected='DiscardOlderProjection')
 add('BG-delivery-replaced',{'instance':'native-main-2'},expected='DiscardRetiredInstance')
 add('BG-delivery-closed',{'live':False},expected='DiscardRetiredInstance')
 add('BG-delivery-transfer',{'owner_generation':'8'},expected='DiscardStaleAuthority')
 add('BG-delivery-root-switch',{'document_uuid':'abcdef08-abcd-4abc-8abc-abcdef012345'},expected='DiscardStaleAuthority')
 add('BG-delivery-restart-session',{'session_uuid':'abcdef09-abcd-4abc-8abc-abcdef012345'},expected='DiscardStaleAuthority')
 return cases
def reduce(state,command,request,caller,evidence):
 """No authoritative mutation. Dependencies are immutable fixture observations only."""
 from schema_subset import Draft202012Validator
 out=copy.deepcopy(state);calls=[]
 allowed=['main','ui-editor'] if command=='open' else ['main','ui-editor','ui-viewer']
 if caller['role']not in allowed or caller['origin']not in ['tauri://localhost','http://tauri.localhost','https://tauri.localhost'] or not caller['live_native_instance']:
  return out,error('UnauthorizedCaller'),calls
 schema=json.loads((P/('h2-design_binding_'+command+'-request.schema.json')).read_text(encoding='utf8'))
 try:Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(request)
 except AssertionError:
  unknown=next((k for k in request if k not in schema['properties']),None)
  missing=next((k for k in schema['required']if k not in request),None)
  field='/'+(unknown or missing or next(iter(schema['properties'])))
  malformed=next(iter(schema['properties']))
  reason='UnknownField' if unknown else 'MissingField' if missing else 'Type' if not isinstance(request.get(malformed),str) else 'InvalidUuid'
  return out,error('InvalidRequest',{'field':field,'reason':reason}),calls
 if command=='get':
  binding=out['attachments'].get(request['binding_ref'])
  if not binding:return out,error('MissingBinding'),calls
  if binding['instance']!=caller['instance']:return out,error('UnauthorizedCaller'),calls
  if not binding['active']:return out,error('MissingBinding'),calls
 else:
  binding=None
  if request['document_reference']not in ['trusted-document']:return out,error('MissingBinding'),calls
 if not evidence['dependency_ready']:return out,error('DependencyNotReady',{'dependency':'M04_OWNER_INTEGRATION'}),calls
 calls.append('M04.attach_document' if command=='open' else 'M04.get_projection')
 # Local trusted fixture authority is an oracle input, never a proposed runtime registry.
 authority=json.loads((P/'trusted-fixture-authority.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
 trusted=authority['observations'].get(evidence['observation_ref'])
 if trusted is None or trusted!=evidence['observation']:return out,error('ProofMismatch'),calls
 observation=trusted
 if observation['native_instance']!=caller['instance']:return out,error('UnauthorizedCaller'),calls
 if observation['project_uuid']!=out['trusted_project_uuid'] or observation['document_uuid']!=out['trusted_document_uuid']:

h2-design_binding_get-request.schema.json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:sga:cx-v3:design_binding_get:request",
  "$defs": {
    "U64Decimal": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 20,
      "pattern": "^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18}|1[0-7][0-9]{18}|18[0-3][0-9]{17}|184[0-3][0-9]{16}|1844[0-5][0-9]{15}|18446[0-6][0-9]{14}|184467[0-3][0-9]{13}|1844674[0-3][0-9]{12}|184467440[0-6][0-9]{10}|1844674407[0-2][0-9]{9}|18446744073[0-6][0-9]{8}|1844674407370[0-8][0-9]{6}|18446744073709[0-4][0-9]{5}|184467440737095[0-4][0-9]{4}|18446744073709550[0-9]{3}|18446744073709551[0-5][0-9]{2}|1844674407370955160[0-9]{1}|1844674407370955161[0-4]|18446744073709551615)(?![\\s\\S])"
    },
    "Identifier": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "Digest": {
      "type": "string",

{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:sga:cx-v3:design_binding_open:request",
  "$defs": {
    "U64Decimal": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 20,
      "pattern": "^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18}|1[0-7][0-9]{18}|18[0-3][0-9]{17}|184[0-3][0-9]{16}|1844[0-5][0-9]{15}|18446[0-6][0-9]{14}|184467[0-3][0-9]{13}|1844674[0-3][0-9]{12}|184467440[0-6][0-9]{10}|1844674407[0-2][0-9]{9}|18446744073[0-6][0-9]{8}|1844674407370[0-8][0-9]{6}|18446744073709[0-4][0-9]{5}|184467440737095[0-4][0-9]{4}|18446744073709550[0-9]{3}|18446744073709551[0-5][0-9]{2}|1844674407370955160[0-9]{1}|1844674407370955161[0-4]|18446744073709551615)(?![\\s\\S])"
    },
    "Identifier": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "Digest": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}(?![\\s\\S])"
    },
    "Unsupported": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "node_id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "reason": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "node_id",
        "type",
        "reason"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "BindingProjection": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "binding_ref": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}(?![\\s\\S])"
        },
        "document_uuid": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}(?![\\s\\S])"
        },
        "session_uuid": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}(?![\\s\\S])"
        },
        "owner_generation": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/U64Decimal"
        },
        "revision": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/U64Decimal"
        },
        "design_json": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "dirty": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "can_edit": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "unsupported": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Unsupported"
          }
        },
        "selection": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "persistence_ready": {
          "type": "boolean"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "binding_ref",
        "document_uuid",
        "session_uuid",
        "owner_generation",
        "revision",
        "design_json",
        "dirty",
        "can_edit",
        "unsupported",
        "selection",
        "persistence_ready"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "Candidate": {
      "type": "object",

          "type": "string",

        },
        "request_id": {

          "minLength": 1
        },
        "captured_revision": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/U64Decimal"
        },

          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Unsupported"
          }
        },
        "installable": {
          "type": "boolean"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "candidate_ref",
        "request_id",
        "captured_revision",
        "unsupported",
        "installable"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "Select": {

          ]

lessons.json
{
  "cause": "Shared schemas contain weak projections and regex end anchors that accept controls; source-shaped fixtures can otherwise be mistaken for issuer proof",
  "correction": "Use strict corrected definitions, generic schema validators, enumerate every physical pattern and root reachability; fixture trust authority separate from wire values",
  "scope": "New open/get packet only; no old suite rerun"
}

module-spec.json
{
  "module": "M03",
  "task": "PD-P1-M03-PREP-01",
  "slice": "Binding open + get only",
  "status": "PROPOSED_PENDING_REACCEPTANCE_AND_OWNER",
  "scope": "Only this new planning folder; no product, Skeleton, board, current-state or old packet writes",
  "author": "/root/m03_binding_lifecycle_packet",
  "independent_acceptance": "PENDING",
  "full_lifecycle": "NOT COMPLETE; close and transfer are deferred separately",
  "intent": "Attach an authorized native view to an identity-bound M04 owner and read current immutable projection without creating another owner or mutating document state",
  "architecture": {
    "hexagonal": "Native UI → design caller adapter → M03 open/get facade → existing M04 attach/get input dependency → M04 sole owner → existing S1",
    "dependency": "M03 facade depends on opaque M04 handle contract only. Native sender identity enters through trusted adapter. No UI filesystem or S1 access.",
    "modules": {
      "M03": "Derived binding and projection delivery",
      "M04": "Authoritative document identity/session/content/history/baselines/writer generation",
      "M01": "Trusted native project/document binding evidence; no identity minted from document_reference"
    },
    "state_ownership": "M04 alone owns exactly one S1 session per trusted document. Fixture observation store is a test double, not a proposed runtime registry. M03 stores only derived attachment handle/instance/generation.",
    "mutation": "Open creates derived view attachment only; get reads. Content, history, revision and dirty baselines unchanged. No S1 construction or direct ownership adoption.",
    "transaction": "Authenticate native caller → validate closed request → resolve trusted reference and identity → M04 attach/get observation → verify observation context → deliver current projection only. No partial facade attachment on failure. No formal IO/ACK/material pin or root transfer.",
    "forbidden": [
      "new owner registry",
      "direct S1 constructor",
      "filesystem load fallback",
      "UI supplied native capability",
      "new manifest/adoption API",
      "implicit writer claim",
      "save proof reused for attach"
    ],
    "system_context": "Local main/editor/viewer windows consume an existing M04 design document; external native identity provider remains outside the M03 boundary",
    "input_ports": [
      "design_binding_open(document_reference)",
      "design_binding_get(binding_ref)"
    ],
    "output_ports": [
      "Existing proposed M04 attach_document(trusted_binding) → opaque DocumentOwnerHandle",
      "Existing proposed M04 get_projection(handle) → immutable projection; exact integration not yet accepted"
    ],
    "driving_adapters": [
      "Native role/origin/instance checked Tauri design command adapter",
      "Document test adapter only"
    ],
    "driven_adapters": [
      "M04 owner integration as existing dependency; absent integration fails closed"
    ],
    "diagrams": {
      "hexagonal": "Native windows → design caller adapter → M03 input commands → derived facade → M04 input port → sole M04 S1 owner",
      "module_dependency": "UI rendering → Tauri caller guard → M03 facade → M04 attach/get contract; M01 trusted identity supplied through owner integration. No backward M04→UI or domain→native dependency."
    }
  },
  "commands": [
    "design_binding_open",
    "design_binding_get"
  ],
  "roots": [
    "h2-design_binding_open-request.schema.json",
    "h2-design_binding_open-response.schema.json",
    "h2-design_binding_get-request.schema.json",
    "h2-design_binding_get-response.schema.json"
  ],
  "contract": {
    "C1": "Unauthorized native sender produces zero dependency calls and no state change",
    "C2": "Missing M04 owner-open integration returns DependencyNotReady(M04_OWNER_INTEGRATION); never invent document content",
    "C3": "document_reference is a lookup hint against trusted binding only; cannot adopt identity, path or writer rights",
    "C4": "Every returned binding/session/document/generation derives from authenticated M04 observation and trusted native instance",
    "C5": "Get never returns another native instance binding; viewer can read only explicitly attached projection",
    "C6": "Repeated open/get are reads/attachments, carry no request_id and promise no mutation replay/exactly-once",
    "C7": "Retired instance, close, transfer, root switch or restart observations fence old bindings; pending old replies cannot install newer UI state",
    "C8": "Unsupported/missing Form projection stays raw and inert with can_edit=false; no C1 filtering/stamping",
    "C9": "No content/history/baseline/revision mutation, no candidate creation or preview grant in open/get"
  },
  "permissions": {
    "open": [
      "main",
      "ui-editor"
    ],
    "get": [
      "main",
      "ui-editor",
      "ui-viewer"
    ],
    "origin": "Only native tauri://localhost or http(s)://tauri.localhost without port; remote/dev origins rejected",
    "instance": "Injected trusted live native window nonce, never labels alone. Viewer get requires preexisting explicit attachment; viewer open denied.",
    "adopt": "M04 integration must supply already approved identity binding; no new adoption behavior authorized"
  },
  "lifecycle": {
    "close": "DEFERRED command; fixture external observation may revoke derived binding, does not implement close",
    "transfer": "DEFERRED command; external M04 generation change invalidates candidates/previews and old bindings by common contract, not a facade ownership mutation",
    "late_ACK": "No ACK called. Late save/install results belong to their original issuer workflow; open/get cannot apply ACK, claim replay or downgrade newer UI projection.",
    "replay": "No request_id in either root. Unknown request_id is rejected. No durable lookup/new H2 reconciliation command added.",
    "restart": "Old binding MissingBinding; new open requires trusted native/current owner observations, cannot claim old mutation result"
  },
  "calls": {
    "M04_attach_or_get": "Document-model fixture only; native integration NOT RUN",
    "S1": "NOT CALLED",
    "formal_IO": "NOT CALLED",
    "formal_ACK": "NOT CALLED",
    "material_pin": "NOT CALLED",
    "save_proof": "NOT APPLICABLE"
  },
  "UI_schema": {
    "component": "Design binding projection",
    "role": "main/editor attach; viewer existing attachment read",
    "controls": "Existing document selection invokes open; refresh invokes get. No new controls proposed",
    "validation": "Closed request schema then trusted identity binding",
    "loading": "Preserve current display with loading marker",
    "error": "Preserve previous display, show safe plain text diagnostic, no blind mutation retry",
    "empty": "MissingBinding diagnostic; never synthesize Form",
    "disabled": "can_edit=false for nonwriter/unsupported/missing Form/dependency unavailable",
    "success": "Install only matching live instance/document/session/generation and nondecreasing revision",
    "accessibility": "Announce diagnostic and loading state; no focus steal"
  },
  "acceptance": [
    "All four complete root schemas self-contained with closed objects and local refs",
    "Every physical UUID/u64/digest pattern audited; reachable root positive/negative probes run in Python and Node",
    "Seven exact DomainRejected objects preserved, never string fields/Debug parsing",
    "Document reducer cases verify zero content mutation and missing dependency/cross-instance fences",
    "796 authority source hashes compared and drift reported",
    "Independent reviewer and Owner adoption pending; no readiness or module-complete claim"
  ],
  "pending_automation": [
    "M04 attach/get integration contract owner review",
    "Native sender/origin/window replacement tests after approved Skeleton and valid RED",
    "Real UI projection delivery ordering test",
    "Separate close/transfer exact command packets and revocation integration tests",
    "Cross-module regression after implementation"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "M04 owner-open integration is not established by these fixture observations",
    "Open deduplication/resource limits are proposed, not an approved runtime capability",
    "No runtime/native/product proof or acceptance performed"
  ],
  "BDD_coverage": [
    {
      "category": "B1 Primary success",
      "status": "Applicable",
      "evidence_or_reason": "BG-01/open and BG-02/get"
    },
    {
      "category": "B2 Input boundaries",
      "status": "Applicable",
      "evidence_or_reason": "empty reference, UUID controls, u64 maximum and overflow"
    },
    {
      "category": "B3 Invalid input",
      "status": "Applicable",
      "evidence_or_reason": "closed roots, missing/unknown fields"
    },
    {
      "category": "B4 Dependency failure",
      "status": "Applicable",
      "evidence_or_reason": "BG-05 missing integration; proof mismatch"
    },
    {
      "category": "B5 Partial failure",
      "status": "Applicable",
      "evidence_or_reason": "Invalid observation leaves no partial facade attachment"
    },
    {
      "category": "B6 State consistency",
      "status": "Applicable",
      "evidence_or_reason": "All document model cases preserve content/history/baselines/revision"
    },
    {
      "category": "B7 Transaction",
      "status": "Applicable",
      "evidence_or_reason": "Attach only after full trusted context verification"
    },
    {
      "category": "B8 Lifecycle",
      "status": "Applicable",
      "evidence_or_reason": "Old generation/session/native instance rejected; delivery fenced"
    },
    {
      "category": "B9 Recovery/rollback",
      "status": "Not Applicable",
      "evidence_or_reason": "No content mutation or rollback. Restart binding invalidation covered without reconciliation implementation"
    },
    {
      "category": "B10 Cross-module",
      "status": "Applicable",
      "evidence_or_reason": "M04/M01 fixture-shaped observations only; real integration pending"
    },
    {
      "category": "B11 Compatibility",
      "status": "Deferred",
      "evidence_or_reason": "Real native OS/platform and existing UI integration require separately approved Skeleton/RED"
    },
    {
      "category": "B12 Regression critical",
      "status": "Deferred",
      "evidence_or_reason": "Old accepted document suites not rerun; product regression NOT RUN"
    }
  ],
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "BG-PREP-OPEN-GET",
      "primary_module": "M03",
      "layer": "Planning document boundary",
      "intent": "Attach an authorized native view to an identity-bound M04 owner and read current immutable projection without creating another owner or mutating document state",
      "allowed_files": [
        "M03/planning/binding-lifecycle-integration/**"
      ],
      "protected_files": [
        "All product/tests",
        "All old planning packages",
        "board",
        "current-state"
      ],
      "contracts": [
        "C1",
        "C2",
        "C3",
        "C4",
        "C5",
        "C6",
        "C7",
        "C8",
        "C9"
      ],
      "BDD": "module.feature + case-scenarios.feature",
      "TDD": "check_documents.py document probes only; product RED NOT RUN",
      "fixture": "fixtures.json and trusted-fixture-authority.json",
      "acceptance": [
        "All four complete root schemas self-contained with closed objects and local refs",
        "Every physical UUID/u64/digest pattern audited; reachable root positive/negative probes run in Python and Node",
        "Seven exact DomainRejected objects preserved, never string fields/Debug parsing",
        "Document reducer cases verify zero content mutation and missing dependency/cross-instance fences",
        "796 authority source hashes compared and drift reported",
        "Independent reviewer and Owner adoption pending; no readiness or module-complete claim"
      ],
      "status": "DOCUMENT_AUTHOR_CHECKED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW",

    }
  ]

module.feature
Feature: Attach and observe a design document
  Background:
    Given the open and get policy is proposed pending independent review and Owner adoption
    And a trusted native caller may request an existing document attachment
  Rule: A view never becomes a second document owner
    Scenario: BG-01 Attach an identity-bound current document
      Given the document already has an authenticated current owner
      When the authorized view opens that document
      Then the view receives the current immutable design projection
      And the document content, history and baselines remain unchanged
    Scenario: BG-02 Read an attached current projection
      Given the current native view has an active attachment
      When the view requests its projection
      Then the current projection is returned without document mutation
    Scenario: BG-05 Missing owner integration
      Given owner attachment integration is unavailable
      When the authorized view opens the trusted document
      Then dependency unavailability is reported
      And no document or attachment is invented
  Rule: Native authority and identity are preserved
    Scenario Outline: Reject an unauthorized or stale request
      Given <condition>
      When a projection is requested
      Then <outcome>
      And document state remains unchanged
      Examples:
        | condition                           | outcome                       |
        | a remote caller                     | caller rejection is reported  |
        | a replaced native window instance   | caller rejection is reported  |
        | an old owner generation             | stale ownership is reported   |
        | an old session                      | stale ownership is reported   |
        | a closed attachment                 | missing binding is reported   |
        | an unknown issuer observation       | proof mismatch is reported    |
        | an empty document reference         | missing binding is reported   |
        | a foreign document identity         | identity conflict is reported |
    Scenario: Existing viewer reads only its explicit attachment
      Given a viewer has a trusted explicit attachment
      When the viewer requests its projection
      Then an immutable read-only projection is returned
    Scenario: Unsupported content remains preserved and inert
      Given a document contains unsupported content
      When an authorized view opens the document
      Then the unsupported content remains present
      And editing remains disabled
  Rule: These commands do not claim mutation replay
    Scenario: An extra request identity is rejected
      Given an otherwise valid document open request
      When an undeclared request identity is included
      Then the request is rejected as an unknown field
      And no owner dependency is called
new-policy-choices.json
[
  {
    "id": "BG-P1",
    "before": "Projection UUID fields previously minLength string; identity prose UUID",
    "after": "Use strict lowercase UUIDv4 projection fields from approved-shaped fixture, proposed wire precision",
    "status": "PROPOSED_PENDING_REACCEPTANCE_AND_OWNER"
  },
  {
    "id": "BG-P2",
    "before": "document_reference is unrestricted wire string; lookup policy unspecified",
    "after": "Keep free-text schema unchanged; empty/unbound reference returns MissingBinding, not new lexical rejection",
    "status": "PROPOSED_PENDING_REACCEPTANCE_AND_OWNER"
  },
  {
    "id": "BG-P3",
    "before": "Repeated open attachment behavior unspecified",
    "after": "Same current native instance and trusted document returns existing derived binding; no additional attachment",
    "status": "PROPOSED_PENDING_REACCEPTANCE_AND_OWNER"
  },
  {
    "id": "BG-P4",
    "before": "M04 evidence verification described, no concrete document oracle",
    "after": "Require fixture-authenticated M04 observation exact native instance/project/document/session/generation, no trust in UI DTO",
    "status": "PROPOSED_PENDING_REACCEPTANCE_AND_OWNER"
  },
  {
    "id": "BG-P5",
    "before": "Old binding/window lifecycle prose",
    "after": "External revocation observation invalidates read delivery; close/transfer commands remain deferred",
    "status": "PROPOSED_PENDING_REACCEPTANCE_AND_OWNER"
  },
  {
    "id": "BG-P6",
    "before": "Response shared DomainRejected placeholder fields string",
    "after": "Reuse corrected seven exact variant objects; open/get model does not synthesize domain mutation errors",
    "status": "PROPOSED_PENDING_REACCEPTANCE_AND_OWNER"
  }
]

probe.cjs
// Generic limited schema subset. No field-name hooks. Document checks only.
const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');
const read=n=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,n),'utf8'));
function valid(root,s,x){
 if(s.$ref){let t=root;for(const k of s.$ref.slice(2).split('/'))t=t[k];return valid(root,t,x);}
 if(s.oneOf)return s.oneOf.filter(t=>valid(root,t,x)).length===1;
 if('const'in s&&JSON.stringify(x)!==JSON.stringify(s.const))return false;
 if(s.enum&&!s.enum.includes(x))return false;
 const kinds={object:x!==null&&typeof x==='object'&&!Array.isArray(x),array:Array.isArray(x),string:typeof x==='string',boolean:typeof x==='boolean',null:x===null};
 if(s.type&&!(Array.isArray(s.type)?s.type:[s.type]).some(k=>kinds[k]))return false;
 if(typeof x==='string'&&(x.length<(s.minLength||0)||x.length>(s.maxLength??1e9)||s.pattern&&!new RegExp(s.pattern).test(x)))return false;
 if(kinds.object){if((s.required||[]).some(k=>!(k in x)))return false;if(s.additionalProperties===false&&Object.keys(x).some(k=>!(k in(s.properties||{}))))return false;if(Object.entries(s.properties||{}).some(([k,z])=>k in x&&!valid(root,z,x[k])))return false;}
 if(kinds.array&&s.items&&x.some(z=>!valid(root,s.items,z)))return false;
 return true;
}
const roots=Object.fromEntries(read('module-spec.json').roots.map(n=>[n,read(n)]));
const a=read('lexical-fixtures.json').map(c=>({id:c.id,expected:c.expected_accept,actual:valid(roots[c.schema],roots[c.schema],c.instance)}));
const b=read('pattern-fixtures.json').map(c=>({id:c.id,expected:c.expected,actual:new RegExp(c.pattern).test(c.value)}));
console.log(JSON.stringify({engine:process.version,root_cases:a.length,definition_cases:b.length,mismatches:[...a,...b].filter(c=>c.actual!==c.expected)}));

import re
import copy
class Draft202012Validator:
 def __init__(self,s):self.s=s
 @staticmethod
 def check_schema(s):assert s.get('$schema')=='https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema'
 def validate(self,x):
  def v(s,x):
   if '$ref' in s:
    t=self.s
    for k in s['$ref'][2:].split('/'):t=t[k]
    return v(t,x)
   if 'oneOf' in s:return sum(v(z,x) for z in s['oneOf'])==1
   if 'const' in s and (type(x)!=type(s['const']) or x!=s['const']):return False
   if 'enum' in s and x not in s['enum']:return False
   kinds={'object':type(x)is dict,'array':type(x)is list,'string':type(x)is str,'boolean':type(x)is bool,'null':x is None}
   t=s.get('type')
   if t and not any(kinds.get(k,False) for k in (t if isinstance(t,list) else [t])):return False
   if type(x)is str:
    if not s.get('minLength',0)<=len(x)<=s.get('maxLength',10**9):return False
    if 'pattern'in s and re.search(s['pattern'],x)is None:return False
   if type(x)is dict:
    if any(k not in x for k in s.get('required',[])):return False
    if s.get('additionalProperties')is False and any(k not in s.get('properties',{}) for k in x):return False
    if any(k in x and not v(z,x[k]) for k,z in s.get('properties',{}).items()):return False
   if type(x)is list and 'items'in s and any(not v(s['items'],z) for z in x):return False
   return True
  assert v(self.s,x),'schema rejection'
